text: Three Bill Sorry to interrupt, but can I have a quick word? Yes, of course What's up? Listen, I need to take the day off on Friday. My son's performing in a school concert Friday I'm afraid that's impossible Are you sure? Sorry, Adam It wouldn't be a problem normally, but we've got a bit of a crisis Vicki's off sick and we really need to complete this order by Saturday Can't someone else help? My son will be so disappointed if I don't watch him play. And I do have some holiday left for this year. I'm sure. But if we're late with this order, we might lose the whole contract. I see. You should really arrange time off with me a month in advance, you know. I know, I know. It's just I've asked you at short notice before and it hasn't been a problem. Well, as I say, normally it isn't. It isn't. Well, I guess that's all. I don't know what I'll tell my son. I'm sorry. You'll be really helping me and the company.
